sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《二十岁心理学》，在这里我们一起探讨二十岁时面临的重大生活改变与人生转型，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody, welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎再次回到节目中。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎再次收听本播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here back for another episode as we, of course, break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 新听众、老听众，无论你身处世界的哪个角落，非常高兴你能回来收听又一期节目，当然，我们要在这里剖析二十岁的心理学。

sentences.en: To begin with, I have a new microphone.
sentences.zh: 首先，我换了一个新麦克风。

sentences.en: My last one broke.
sentences.zh: 我上一个坏了。

sentences.en: I feel like a few of you noticed it in a few of the last episodes.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你们中的一些人已经在最近的几期节目里听出来了。

sentences.en: It was just like not doing its job.
sentences.zh: 它就是那种罢工了的感觉。

sentences.en: It wasn't working out for me, so I have this new one.
sentences.zh: 它不太适合我，所以我换了这个新的。

sentences.en: I'm hoping that from here on out, there is less crackling.
sentences.zh: 我希望从今以后，杂音能少一点。

sentences.en: This is a funny story, but I recently moved house and I accidentally moved underneath a international flight path.
sentences.zh: 这是一个挺逗的故事，我最近搬了家，结果不小心搬到了一条国际航线下头。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that has been a factor in recordings recently, whereby every time I try and sit down to do an episode, suddenly there is like a Boeing 707 flying over my ceiling.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，这成了最近录音的一个干扰因素，每当我试图坐下来录一期节目时，突然就会有一架类似波音 707 的飞机从我的天花板轰鸣飞过。

sentences.en: This microphone will hopefully stop that from filtering in because I feel like I want these conversations to be nice and peaceful and not interrupted by loud, obnoxious noises.
sentences.zh: 希望这个麦克风能阻止这些噪音渗进来，因为我觉得我希望这些对话是美好的、宁静的，而不是被刺耳、讨厌的噪音打断的。

sentences.en: So that is my first update.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的第一个近况更新。

sentences.en: My second update is not an update.
sentences.zh: 我的第二个更新其实不算更新。

sentences.en: I'm just going to introduce what we're talking about today because today we're going to be discussing social media, arguably one of the biggest influences in our lives
sentences.zh: 我只是要引入我们今天的话题，因为今天我们要讨论的是社交媒体，可以说它是过去 10 年里对我们生活影响最大的事物之一，

sentences.en: and I think society to emerge in the last 10 years.
sentences.zh: 也是对社会影响最大的事物之一。

sentences.en: And what I really want to do today is just have a discussion around how potentially harmful it has become, how little we tend to consider its impact on our health,
sentences.zh: 而我今天真正想做的是，探讨它变得有多大潜在危害，我们是多么少地去考虑它对我们健康的影响，

sentences.en: on our beliefs, on our confidence, our self-esteem, our relationships, our friendships, even our careers to an extent.
sentences.zh: 对我们的信仰、自信、自尊、人际关系、友谊，甚至在某种程度上对我们职业生涯的影响。

sentences.en: It just seems that social media has become this all-consuming influence in our lives.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体似乎已经变成了我们生活中这种无孔不入的力量。

sentences.en: It's become so ubiquitous that we don't really sit with the feeling and the thoughts and the psychology behind what that might be doing to us as a species.
sentences.zh: 它变得如此无处不在，以至于我们并没有真正静下心来去感受、思考背后的心理学，想想这到底会对我们这个物种造成什么影响。

sentences.en: For so many of us, I think it's honestly so strange to imagine a world before social media became part of our lives.
sentences.zh: 对于我们当中的许多人来说，老实说，去想象一个社交媒体尚未融入我们生活的世界，真的是一件极其陌生的大事。

sentences.en: You know, when we took pictures just for ourselves and our photo albums and we got our news from a newspaper and we picked our restaurants from the local guidebook
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那时我们拍照纯粹是为了自己和相册，我们从报纸上获取新闻，我们靠当地的旅游指南挑选餐馆，

sentences.en: rather than going on TikTok, it really has just completely changed our way of life.
sentences.zh: 而不是去刷 TikTok，它真的彻底改变了我们的生活方式。

sentences.en: And I think for all the good that it has created,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，尽管它创造了种种好处，

sentences.en: yes, we cannot deny the benefits.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们不能否认它的益处。

sentences.en: I think it's also time that we start talking about the societal, cultural and individual impact of our social media consumption
sentences.zh: 我觉得也是时候开始讨论我们对社交媒体的消费所带来的社会、文化和个人影响了，

sentences.en: and how it continues to dominate so much of what is important and priceless in our life.
sentences.zh: 以及它是如何继续主导着我们生活中那么多重要且无价的事物的。

sentences.en: Our time, our self-esteem, our self-perception, our beliefs, our understanding of the world.
sentences.zh: 我们的时间、我们的自尊、我们的自我认知、我们的信仰、我们对世界的理解。

sentences.en: We are really seeing in front of our eyes a complete shift in how we interact with each other, how we connect, how we date, how we establish our identity.
sentences.zh: 我们正亲眼目睹着人际交往方式、联系方式、约会方式以及自我认同建立方式的彻底转变。

sentences.en: And I don't think that we think about it nearly enough, nor do we take the time to identify when our social media usage is taking over and perhaps even making us sick in a way.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们对此思考得远远不够，也没有花时间去识别我们的社交媒体使用何时已经失控，甚至在某种程度上让我们生病。

sentences.en: It has made me sick mentally and then emotionally and finally physically it all kind of took its toll.
sentences.zh: 它先是让我精神生病，然后是情绪上，最后是生理上，这一切最终都对我的身心造成了沉重的打击。

sentences.en: And I think also when you come to that point of realization of like social media is ruining my mental health, it is making me so tired, so burnt out,
sentences.zh: 而且我也觉得，当你到达那种顿悟的时刻，觉得“社交媒体正在毁掉我的心理健康，它让我精疲力竭、心力交瘁，

sentences.en: it is turning me from a very optimistic person to a negative person.
sentences.zh: 它把我从一个极度乐观的人变成了一个消极的人”时，

sentences.en: What do you do about that?
sentences.zh: 你该怎么做？

sentences.en: How do you move forward?
sentences.zh: 你如何继续前行？

sentences.en: I feel like you have a diagnosis and there isn't necessarily a solution and you might be rolling your eyes right now thinking, well, no one's forcing you to stay online,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就好比你拿到了诊断结果，但未必有现成的解决方案，你现在可能正翻着白眼想着，又没人强迫你上网，

sentences.en: like just log off, just delete your accounts.
sentences.zh: 直接注销登录不就完了，直接删号不就得了。

sentences.en: But I also think that that is a lot easier said than done when we begin to really examine how addictive these platforms have been designed to be.
sentences.zh: 但我也觉得，当我们开始真正审视这些平台被设计得有多么容易上瘾时，这绝对是说起来容易做起来难。

sentences.en: There is intention behind capturing our attention, let's not deny it.
sentences.zh: 捕获我们的注意力是带有明确意图的，我们别不承认。

sentences.en: And also how you really, by choosing to not be present on social media, you kind of lock yourself out of a lot of possibility for interaction and to create friendships
sentences.zh: 而且，通过选择不活跃在社交媒体上，你实际上也把自己关在了大量互动、结交朋友的可能性大门之外，

sentences.en: and to maintain friendships as well.
sentences.zh: 并且也无法很好地维系友谊。

sentences.en: The only way I can kind of describe this impact, the impact that this has had on me, is that my brain has begun to feel very rotted, kind of from the inside out.
sentences.zh: 我能形容这种冲击、它对我造成的冲击的唯一方式，就是我的大脑开始感觉像是从内到外都彻底腐烂了。

sentences.en: Something has been getting rewired in my mind for a while and I think there have been certain things that have just made me snap recently, certain experiences.
sentences.zh: 我的思维在一段时间里经历了一些重构，而且我觉得最近有一些特定的事情让我彻底崩溃了，一些特定的经历。

sentences.en: There is this spotlight that seems to be constantly on us on social media.
sentences.zh: 在社交媒体上，似乎永远有一道聚光灯无时不刻地打在我们身上。

sentences.en: Anyone can find out anything, anyone can say anything that they want with really no repercussions and that is just so strange.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以查到任何事，任何人都可以畅所欲言却完全无需承担后果，这真的太诡异了。

sentences.en: It is a huge difference from the environment, our brain and all of its neurological systems originally developed and evolved in.
sentences.zh: 这与我们的大脑以及它所有的神经系统最初发展和进化时所处的环境有着天壤之别。

sentences.en: One of limited mass group contact and small communities.
sentences.zh: 那是一个有限的大群体接触和小社区的环境。

sentences.en: You know, we aren't meant to have this much exposure to so many connections and be aware of so many people and have so many opportunities to judge and to be judged.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们本不该承受如此密集的连接曝光，去关注这么多人，拥有这么多去评判他人以及被人评判的机会。

sentences.en: Not only do I think it really skews what we see as normal and it promotes a sense of inadequacy, innate social comparison, whether that is to do with our bodies, our lives,
sentences.zh: 我不但认为它严重扭曲了我们对正常的看法，滋生了一种不安全感和与生俱来的社交攀比心理——无论是关于我们的身材、生活、

sentences.en: how many friends we have, our jobs, but I also think sometimes there is just too much information for our brains to process and we just experience an overload at times.
sentences.zh: 朋友数量还是工作，而且我也觉得有时候信息实在太多，超出了我们大脑的处理能力，导致我们有时会经历超载。

sentences.en: Everything just seems a little bit too serious and real online when it's not.
sentences.zh: 网络上的每件事看起来都有点过于严肃和真实了，然而事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Social media is not real and I know it's insanely cliche to say that, but seriously, if you were to base your perception of reality on what you saw online,
sentences.zh: 社交媒体不是真实的，我知道说这话简直俗不可耐，但说真的，如果你把对现实的认知建立在你在网上看到的东西上，

sentences.en: I would not want to live in that world.
sentences.zh: 我是绝对不愿意生活在那种世界里的。

sentences.en: Okay, I know I'm sounding so pessimistic, but that has just been my experience as everything in my life has gotten progressively better and more stable and positive.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我知道我听起来太悲观了，但这确实是我的亲身经历——尽管我生活中的一切都在逐渐变得更好、更稳定、更积极，

sentences.en: The one aspect that remains a source of real frustration and sometimes pain is social media and all the secondary emotional states and reactions that it just seems
sentences.zh: 唯独有一个方面依然是真正的挫败感甚至是痛苦的来源，那就是社交媒体，以及它似乎在我体内引发的所有次生情感状态和反应，

sentences.en: to cause within me and this has been especially exaggerated in the past three months and I want to talk about it because how can we not talk about it?
sentences.zh: 过去三个月里这种感觉尤其被无限放大，我想谈谈这个，因为我们怎么能不谈谈呢？

sentences.en: As people in our 20s, arguably this is the most formative decade of our adult lives, how much is social media impacting our psychology in unconscious ways?
sentences.zh: 作为二十几岁的人，这可以说是我们成年生活中最具塑造力的十年，社交媒体正在以多么无意识的方式影响着我们的心理？

sentences.en: Because it is more than we are probably willing to acknowledge or confront and what is the solution there?
sentences.zh: 因为这种影响可能远超我们愿意承认或面对的程度，那解决方案又是什么呢？

sentences.en: I don't think
sentences.zh: 我不认为

sentences.en: I'm one to complain about something whilst also not thinking about what comes next, what else is possible because social media is embedded in our lives in so many ways.
sentences.zh: 我是那种只会抱怨却不去思考接下来该怎么办、还有什么其他可能性的人，因为社交媒体已经以太多方式嵌入了我们的生活。

sentences.en: I think it's kind of like alcohol or caffeine or processed sugar.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它有点像酒精、咖啡因或加工糖。

sentences.en: It's addictive but we can find ways to be healthier and more sustainable about our consumption whilst also not completely limiting ourselves from some of the pleasure
sentences.zh: 它让人上瘾，但我们可以找到更健康、更可持续的方式来消费它，同时又不至于完全剥夺自己本该享受的某些快乐

sentences.en: and some of the good that it does give us.
sentences.zh: 以及它带给我们的某些好处。

sentences.en: To begin with,
sentences.zh: 首先，

sentences.en: I'm going to kind of talk through my own experience and what's kind of led me to come to this revelation that social media is negatively impacting, perhaps ruining
sentences.zh: 我打算梳理一下我自己的经历，以及是什么促使我得出“社交媒体正在对我的心理健康产生负面影响，甚至可以说是毁掉它”这一顿悟的。

sentences.en: my mental health.
sentences.zh: 我的心理健康。

sentences.en: I think that I never imagined that social media was going to play such a huge role in my life.
sentences.zh: 我想我从未想象过社交媒体会在我的生活中扮演如此重要的角色。

sentences.en: When I was younger in my teen years, I kind of stayed away from social media.
sentences.zh: 我年轻时的青少年时期，其实是刻意远离社交媒体的。

sentences.en: I went, I think I like quit social media for like a year at one point.
sentences.zh: 我有过一段经历，好像有那么一年我都把社交媒体给戒了。

sentences.en: There's always kind of been this conscious part of me that's recognised that it is doing things to our brains that we are probably not fully aware of and then I started
sentences.zh: 我的内心深处一直有一种清醒的意识，认识到它正在对我们的大脑做一些我们可能并未完全意识到的事情，然后我就开始创办了

sentences.en: this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这个播客。

sentences.en: When I started the show, obviously, if you have been a loyal day one listener of which there are probably very few of you because it really was just like my parents and my friends
sentences.zh: 当我刚开始做这个节目的时候，显然，如果你是一个从第一天起就关注的忠实听众——虽然这样的人可能寥寥无几，因为当时真的就只有我爸妈、我的朋友

sentences.en: and my grandma,
sentences.zh: 还有我奶奶，

sentences.en: I really just wanted to share my own experiences in my 20s.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的只是想分享我自己在二十几岁时的亲身经历。

sentences.en: Kind of,
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，

sentences.en: I remember having this thought that this kind of project would be great for me to look back on in the future and have like a catalogue, like almost diary-like entries and voice
sentences.zh: 我记得当时有过这样一个想法：这个项目对我以后回看会非常有意义，能让我拥有一个目录，就像日记一样的条目，以及我当时经历的语音备忘录，

sentences.en: memos of what I was experiencing at the time, like a journal.
sentences.zh: 就像一本日志一样。

sentences.en: And then I just got so into it.
sentences.zh: 然后我就彻底迷上了。

sentences.en: I was so passionate about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此充满了热情。

sentences.en: There was so much to talk about.
sentences.zh: 有太多的话题可以聊了。

sentences.en: People started following and now social media has become a component of my career as the podcast has become my full-time job, which I'm so lucky to be able to say.
sentences.zh: 人们开始关注我，现在社交媒体已经成了我职业生涯的一个组成部分，因为播客已经成了我的全职工作，对此我感到非常幸运。

sentences.en: It's interesting that social media becomes, is hand-in-hand with that.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，社交媒体与此息息相关、形影不离。

sentences.en: Even though I'm doing something that is completely separate from
sentences.zh: 尽管我在做的事情跟

sentences.en: Instagram, from TikTok, you know,
sentences.zh: Instagram、TikTok 完全没有关系，你知道的，

sentences.en: I'm making a podcast,
sentences.zh: 我在做一档播客，

sentences.en: I'm talking into a microphone about psychology and mental health and our 20s, there is this expectation that you need to have an online presence to kind of make your podcast
sentences.zh: 我在对着麦克风谈论心理学、心理健康和我们的二十岁，但外界却有一种期待：你必须得有线上存在感，才能让你的播客

sentences.en: or I guess like make your job and your career seem legitimate, right?
sentences.zh: 或者说让你的工作和职业生涯显得合法正规，对吧？

sentences.en: Like how can people know that you are doing good stuff and how can people find you if they can't find you through the platforms that they spend their most time on
sentences.zh: 比如人们怎么知道你在做好东西呢？如果他们无法通过他们花最多时间的平台找到你——

sentences.en: through Instagram, through TikTok, through X, through whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 通过 Instagram、通过 TikTok、通过 X，或者无论什么平台。
